Arclin Manufacturing - Demand Planning
Blueprint Workshop Notes
Client Overview
Client Name: Arclin Manufacturing Inc.
Industry: Specialty Chemicals Manufacturing
Headquarters: Georgia, USA
ERP System: SAP S/4HANA
Current Planning Tool: Excel-based planning process
Project Objective: Implement Kinaxis RapidResponse for Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and
Inventory Optimization.
Current Challenges
Demand planners spend significant time consolidating forecasts from multiple regions.
Forecast accuracy is approximately 68%.
No centralized planning platform exists across North America and Europe.

Headquarters: Georgia, USA

No centralized planning platform exists across North America and Europe.
